description:
Advances: ancora.gate

Severity: Medium (calibrated; critical review 2026-09-05, consolidated F27, testing M2). Evidence: tag identity for tags/tag_borrowed is {file, test_name}, so renaming a test file or a test fires the disclosure on an unchanged requirement even though no tag was added; reproduced on a real repo; no test pins the behavior either way. Question to decide: is a rename a borrow (disclose) or a move (silent)? If move, define the identity that survives renames and test both. Ready-for: investigate.
title: Decide whether a moved or renamed tag counts as a borrowed tag
